Editorial recommendation: trial luggage, phone connection and tailgate access before committing.
FACTS_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_BODY: No factory model-year claim: article is a dated New Zealand reference specification, not universal MY2026.
Do not call the 340 km figure an independently WLTP-tested or homologated result; brochure says CLTC converted using NZ government calculator.
No Malaysia Essential/Premier, Hong Kong E2/E2+, Singapore 99 kW or China Nammi 06 specification equivalence.
Do not claim a five-star ANCAP or Euro NCAP result; NZ VSRR is a different framework and regulator record was not independently checked.
No global warranty, export eligibility, registration, taxes, freight or current-price guarantees.
No general real-world range derived from review consumption.
Do not assume powered tailgate or Android Auto standard; verify accessories and invoice.
No safety-bypass, battery-testing, camping-while-driving or V2L wiring instructions.
No third-party photographs without documented rights.
